numeric_contract.order: numeric values beat NaN for both largest/smallest; unequal numerics use requested direction; ties including signed zero, equal infinities and all NaNs choose smallest original index
numeric_contract.associativity: ArgBest selects one extremum under that index-completed order; chunking changes no arithmetic reduction or sort meaning
numeric_contract.bits: arg_finish rereads original T bytes after choosing the index, so comparison NaN quieting cannot rewrite the published payload/sign
numeric_contract.tail: arg_tiles bounds each loop by min(first+2048,width); INT32_MAX is the identity and cannot beat any valid index; every configured tile has at least one input
numeric_contract.layout: dense inner1 uses original byte loads; otherwise existing Layout.read maps original logical axis/strides; rows1 implies all non-axis extents have product1
numeric_contract.workspace: ceil(width/2048)*sizeof(ArgPair<float>), 256-byte rounded once in configure; vocabulary248320 gives122 partials/976 bytes rounded1024; caller Invocation owns it
